summary: Comprehensive testing of new features: Unified Roster, Role Requests, Drives CRUD, Activity Logging. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for all new tabs and features.

Admin stats endpoint returns role_requests.pending, members.total, drives.total
GET /api/drives is public (no auth required)
POST /api/admin/drives requires admin auth (401)
Admin can create a new drive with title, description, date, location, drive_type
Admin can delete a drive
DELETE nonexistent drive returns 404
GET /api/admin/role-requests returns list of role requests
POST /api/role-requests requires authentication (401)
GET /api/admin/role-requests requires admin role (401)
Approve nonexistent role request returns 404
Reject nonexistent role request returns 404
GET /api/admin/activity-logs returns list of logs with action, timestamp, user, details
Activity logs requires admin auth (401)
Activity logs respects limit parameter
GET /api/admin/users returns unified roster with all roles
Users endpoint requires admin auth (401)
POST /api/auth/register endpoint exists
POST /api/auth/send-otp endpoint works
DELETE nonexistent user returns 404
Admin cannot delete their own account (400)
Frontend: Registration form shows Member/Volunteer role selection buttons
Frontend: Age field auto-calculates from DOB (read-only)
Frontend: Admin Dashboard shows all new tabs (Overview, Donations, Roster, Requests, Drives, Queries, Messages, Tickets, Activity Log)
Frontend: Overview stats show Volunteers, Members, Pending Requests, Drives counts
Frontend: Roster tab shows unified user list with role filter (All/Admin/Volunteer/Member)
Frontend: Drives tab shows New Drive button and drive creation form
Frontend: Drives tab shows existing drives with delete button
Frontend: Role Requests tab shows pending requests section
Frontend: Activity Log tab shows timestamped action log table
critical_code_review_comments: All new endpoints properly protected with require_admin dependency
GET /api/drives is correctly public for non-authenticated users
Activity logging captures all admin actions with timestamps
Role change request flow prevents duplicate pending requests
Admin cannot request role change to 'admin' (only volunteer/member allowed)
Frontend properly displays role badges with color coding
Drive form validates required fields (title, date, location)
